mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for three consecutive months, it signals severe labor market distress that triggers corporate cost-cutting and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or joint Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery (INDPRO > 95), sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO rising for two months) signals strengthening supply chains and corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 95 and INDPRO growth is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) immediately boosts market liquidity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), declining housing starts (HOUST) signal reduced consumer confidence in housing, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and HOUST declines, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 90 for 2 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.03.
